'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Peter Jacobson LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Jacobson]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Jeps' Senate: AKA FILLABUSTED!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
